statement: Logical access to systems is restricted using unique user accounts and least privilege.
Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all access to production systems.
Access is removed promptly when a person leaves the organisation.
User access rights are reviewed at least quarterly.
Data in transit is protected with encryption.
Data at rest is protected with strong encryption and managed keys.
Security events are logged and logs are retained for at least one year.
Vendors are assessed for security risk before onboarding and re-assessed periodically.
A documented incident response plan exists and is tested.
Affected individuals are notified of personal data breaches within a defined period.
Backups are taken regularly and backup restoration is tested.
The organisation operates a disaster recovery site on a Mars colony.
